definitions.explanation: An object made by skilled manual work, often combining artistic beauty with practical function. Includes pottery, lacquerware, textiles, metalwork, and other traditional or modern crafts.

examples.japanese: {伝統的|でんとうてき}{工芸品|こうげいひん}を{買|か}った。
examples.english: I bought a traditional craft product.

examples.japanese: この{地域|ちいき}は{漆器|しっき}の{工芸品|こうげいひん}で{有名|ゆうめい}だ。
examples.english: This area is famous for its lacquerware crafts.

examples.japanese: {職人|しょくにん}が{一|ひと}つひとつ{手作|てづく}りした{工芸品|こうげいひん}は、{大量|たいりょう}{生産品|せいさんひん}にはない{温|あたた}かみがある。
examples.english: Handicrafts made one by one by artisans have a warmth that mass-produced goods lack.

notes:
USAGE: Japan has a national designation system for {伝統的|でんとうてき}{工芸品|こうげいひん} (Traditional Craft Products), which currently recognizes over 200 types across the country. Common examples include {有田焼|ありたやき} (Arita porcelain), {輪島塗|わじまぬり} (Wajima lacquerware), and {西陣織|にしじんおり} (Nishijin textiles).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {伝統的|でんとうてき}{工芸品|こうげいひん}: traditional craft product
- {工芸品|こうげいひん}を{作|つく}る: to make crafts
- {工芸品|こうげいひん}{店|てん}: craft shop
- {民芸品|みんげいひん}: folk craft
